problem: The first exemption branch treats any non-IA/IA iceClass value as sufficient to exempt the ship. A ship having both an applicable value (IA or IA Super) and a non-applicable value can therefore bypass the mandatory compliance and deadline checks.
required_change: Make the applicability test require that no applicable IA or IA Super value exists, or otherwise enforce a single authoritative iceClass before applying the exemption logic.
regression_guard: Preserve applicability for every ship with an IA or IA Super iceClass, including graphs that contain additional iceClass values.
